gates.name: word_count
gates.detail: 201 spoken words; need 180-225. Add about 1 words.

gates.name: hook_trigger
gates.detail: hook needs a number, a 'you', or a contradiction in the first line.

gates.name: hook_text
gates.detail: on-screen hook 'YOUR BANK IS DRAINING YOUR CASH' should be 2-7 words.

gates.name: loop_ending
gates.detail: end the last line mid-thought so it loops back into the hook.

gates.name: originality
gates.detail: too close to an earlier video (similarity 0.33); change the angle and hook.

gates.name: pillar_structure
gates.detail: a 'Do This Today' video must deliver three numbered steps: start beats with 'Step one.', 'Step two.', 'Step three.' and keep each step concrete.

gates.name: voice_quality
gates.detail: reads like generic AI copy (compression classifier): swap filler for concrete numbers, names, and short spoken sentences; cut phrases like 'financial journey' and 'unlock'

gates.name: readability
gates.detail: average sentence is 11.6 words; aim for 8-14.

gates.name: judge_hook
gates.detail: hook scored 7/10. Clarify the math in line 6 by saying 'At a 5% APY, $10,000 earns $500, compared to just $1 at 0.01%.'; Tighten the hook visuals to immediately show a banking app balance dropping to emphasize the 'draining' concept.

gates.name: judge_retention
gates.detail: retention scored 8/10. Clarify the math in line 6 by saying 'At a 5% APY, $10,000 earns $500, compared to just $1 at 0.01%.'; Tighten the hook visuals to immediately show a banking app balance dropping to emphasize the 'draining' concept.

gates.name: judge_value
gates.detail: value scored 9/10. Clarify the math in line 6 by saying 'At a 5% APY, $10,000 earns $500, compared to just $1 at 0.01%.'; Tighten the hook visuals to immediately show a banking app balance dropping to emphasize the 'draining' concept.

gates.name: judge_facts
gates.detail: factual risk 1/10: A $10,000 emergency fund earns roughly $400 to $500 a year in an HYSA, versus $1 at a regular bank. (Assumes specific rates like 4-5% vs 0.01%, which should be explicitly stated as an example).
